That threshold is where I observed a real drop-off in both supervision quality and the ability to give meaningful assignment help. As for the scheduling conflict Mr. Rivera raised, if the Annex is available on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, we could shift the center to two of those days — perhaps Mondays and Wednesdays, or whichever pairing works best for the cleared staff Ms. Chen identified. On the staffing question, I think it makes sense to require that all volunteers have current youth-protection clearance before they begin, and in the meantime, we should rely on the cleared staff Ms. Chen mentioned rather than assuming volunteers will be available. I'd want to make sure we're not compromising on supervision ratios, especially if we're capping at 18 — that number was manageable with one teacher, but only just.
